segments.name: Origination and Servicing
products: residential mortgage origination and servicing platforms
segments.description: Originates and services residential mortgages, including through Newrez, and holds mortgage servicing rights and related assets.
segments.evidence: The Origination and Servicing segment includes our residential mortgage origination and servicing platforms and related investments, including MSRs and servicer advance assets.

segments.name: Residential Transitional Lending
segments.description: Provides business-purpose bridge and construction financing to residential real estate investors, developers and sponsors.
segments.evidence: Residential transition lending refers to business-purpose financing typically provided to residential real estate investors, developers and other sponsors for transitional use cases

segments.name: Asset Management
segments.description: Manages private credit, fund liquidity and insurance strategies for institutional investors through its asset managers.
segments.evidence: expanding our asset management capabilities across private credit, fund liquidity and insurance strategies

segments.name: Investment Portfolio
segments.description: Acquires, finances and manages balance sheet investments across asset classes as an institutional investor.
segments.evidence: In acquiring, financing and managing investments within our Investment Portfolio segment, we compete with a range of institutional investors and asset owners

revenueModel.text: Borrowers, fund investors and counterparties pay Rithm interest and fees on mortgages, loans, asset management and balance sheet investments.
revenueModel.evidence: These segments reflect how we deploy capital, manage risk and generate earnings across our operating businesses, fee-based activities and balance sheet investments.

changes.text: In 2025 Rithm acquired Crestline, expanding its asset management capabilities across private credit, fund liquidity and insurance strategies.
changes.evidence: On December 1, 2025, we completed the acquisition of Crestline for a purchase price of approximately $324.7 million
